speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been going on for about two months, and the shortness of breath definitely gets worse when I try to walk up stairs or carry heavy tools. The sputum is usually greenish, but I haven't had a fever or lost any weight recently. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the greenish sputum suggests an infection, but the exertional shortness of breath and two-month duration are concerning for chronic lung issues. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray and Sputum_Culture. Once we have these results, I will provide the final disease classification you need for your insurance coding.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with acute bacterial exacerbation.
